description:
Remove your emoji reaction from a Slack message.

Only removes the connected user's own reaction — other people's reactions on
the same message are unaffected. Use list_slack_emoji to discover custom emoji
names.

name.description: Emoji name without colons (e.g., thumbsup, heart, eyes)

timestamp.description: Message timestamp — use the ts_slack value from get_slack_channel_history.

name: remove_slack_reaction
